title: Sync Pipeline
description:
What this run SAID — the log view. Progress, failures and linker results read straight from the region worker's output.

Measurements moved out. The Ingestion Pipeline dashboard answers "where did the time go" from real metrics, and this one answers "what happened, in the worker's own words". The old 'Ingest rate' panel here was a count of 'Flushed batch' log lines multiplied by 10,000 — an estimate, not a measurement — and it was removed rather than kept beside the real number, because two different answers to 'how fast is the sync' is worse than one.

panels.title: Sync progress
panels.description: Batch counters and phase transitions. The '(N total)' figure is cumulative records read from the source file, not rows written — they differ whenever the upsert key collapses duplicates.

panels.title: Linker results
panels.description: Post-sync attribution. 'linked' is rows successfully resolved; 'noCoverPage' and 'noCommittee' split the remainder by cause — the first means the join source never arrived, the second that it did but referenced an unknown committee.

panels.title: Error rate by service
panels.description: Errors and warnings across the stack. A sync that fails silently still shows up here — several failure paths log a warning and continue rather than failing the job.

panels.title: Recent errors
panels.description: Raw error lines, newest first. Start here when a sync reports success but the data looks wrong.
